+"""RoboTwin place_burger_fries episode trajectory.
+
+Run a named stage with ``PYTHONPATH=/opt/tools python /app/output/gen.py STAGE``.
+All scene estimates come from camera images and depth; no simulator state is used.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/runs')
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+CAMERAS = ('head_camera', 'front_camera', 'left_camera', 'right_camera',
+           'observer_camera', 'world_camera1')
+
+
+def row(left, right):
+    return np.asarray([*left, *right], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def current_ee(obs):
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']['now']
+    return np.asarray([*p[14:21], p[28], *p[21:28], p[29]], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def record(r, name, action=None, note=''):
+    if action is None:
+        res = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
+    else:
+        res = r.submit('ee_pose', action, cameras=CAMERAS,
+                       video='frames', video_fps=5, include_depth=True,
+                       note=note)
+    res.save(str(OUT / name))
+    p = res.meta['proprio']['now']
+    print(json.dumps({'stage': name, 'done': res.meta.get('done'),
+                      'reason': res.meta.get('reason'),
+                      'time_left_s': res.meta.get('time_left_s'),
+                      'plan': res.meta.get('plan'),
+                      'ee': p[14:28], 'gripper_cmd': p[28:30],
+                      'gripper_meas': [p[36], p[43]],
+                      'tcp': p[56:70]}, default=str))
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    stage = sys.argv[1]
+    r = Robot()
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS)
+    p = current_ee(o)
+    ql = p[3:7].tolist()
+    qr = p[11:15].tolist()
+    if stage == 'pregrasp':
+        # The open finger centres are just behind the food, above the table.
+        target = row([-.254, -.325, .825, *ql, 1],
+                     [.260, -.315, .825, *qr, 1])
+        record(r, stage, target, 'open grippers near burger and fries')
+    elif stage == 'contact':
+        target = row([-.254, -.255, .790, *ql, 1],
+                     [.260, -.235, .790, *qr, 1])
+        record(r, stage, target, 'advance fingers to food')
+    elif stage == 'close':
+        p[7] = 0
+        p[15] = 0
+        record(r, stage, p, 'close on burger and fries')
+    elif stage == 'lift':
+        p[2] = .935
+        p[10] = .935
+        record(r, stage, p, 'lift both foods')
+    elif stage == 'tray':
+        # Distinct tray landing spots to leave room for both foods.
+        p[0:3] = [-.070, -.235, .875]
+        p[8:11] = [.070, -.235, .875]
+        record(r, stage, p, 'carry both foods over tray')
+    elif stage == 'lower':
+        p[2] = .795
+        p[10] = .795
+        record(r, stage, p, 'lower foods into tray')
+    elif stage == 'release':
+        p[7] = 1
+        p[15] = 1
+        record(r, stage, p, 'release foods onto tray')
+    elif stage == 'retreat':
+        p[2] = .950
+        p[10] = .950
+        record(r, stage, p, 'retreat from tray')
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(stage)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch"))
